app.name: Certified Financial Controller Platform
app.tagline: An integrated platform for managing a company portfolio, trial balances, financial statements and professional analysis

auth.signInSubtitle: A secure workspace for the certified financial controller, the team and the office clients.
auth.invalid: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is not active.
auth.demoHint: Click an account to fill the login details automatically.
auth.sessionNote: Encrypted local session. In production the platform connects to a cloud identity and permission provider.
auth.reviewerDesc: Certified reviewer - approves trial balances and statements
auth.clientDesc: Company finance manager - own company portal only

portfolio.title: Trusted financial leadership, statements that reflect the truth
portfolio.subtitle: A complete workspace for the senior certified financial controller: a diverse company portfolio, smart trial balances, automatic financial statements, advanced analysis and an uncompromising audit trail.
portfolio.aboutText1: A specialised office for certified financial controller services, delivering high-level professional work that safeguards the integrity of financial statements, complies with international standards and supports decision makers with reliable financial information.
portfolio.aboutText2: We serve every legal form, size and activity: joint stock, limited liability and partnership companies, international, large, medium and small entities, as well as medical, pharmacy, law, supermarket and craftsman practices.
portfolio.service1: Review and approval of financial statements under international standards
portfolio.service2: Preparation and analysis of financial statements and trial balances
portfolio.service3: Tax and financial advisory and feasibility studies
portfolio.service5: Internal audit, inspection and control assessment
portfolio.service6: Investment decision support and performance evaluation
portfolio.cert4: Financial analysis, valuation and internal control
portfolio.cap1: A smart trial balance template generated from the company's legal form, size and activity.
portfolio.cap2: Excel import or direct entry through the company portal, with explicit review and approval.
portfolio.cap3: Six financial statements generated automatically with detailed analysis for each statement.
portfolio.cap4: Full audit trail, archived approved versions, reminders and backup.
portfolio.trust: Scientific accuracy · Absolute independence · Professional confidentiality · Analytical vision
portfolio.ctaText: Sign in to manage your companies, generate trial balance templates and produce approved financial statements.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: A complete view of the company portfolio, pending work and critical dates.
dashboard.pendingSubtitle: No data is used to issue statements before explicit approval.
dashboard.remindersSubtitle: Reviews, meetings, deliveries and follow-up tasks.
dashboard.portfolioSubtitle: Company performance and latest approved year.
dashboard.activitySubtitle: Every action is recorded with the user and time.

companies.title: Company portfolio
companies.subtitle: Manage companies across forms, sizes, activities and currencies.
companies.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, code or registration number...
companies.empty: No matching companies. Add the first company to start.
companies.createHint: The legal form, size and activity determine the smart trial balance template and chart of accounts.
companies.deleteBlocked: A company with an approved trial balance cannot be deleted. You may archive it instead.
companies.templateReady: The chart of accounts and smart template were generated automatically.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.subtitle: A bilingual hierarchical chart built on the company's smart template.
accounts.empty: No accounts for this company. Generate the smart template or add an account manually.
accounts.syncDone: The chart of accounts was synced with the template.
accounts.deleteBlocked: The account is used in a trial balance and cannot be deleted.

tb.generatorSubtitle: The template is built automatically from the legal form, activity and size, then sent to the company for balance entry.
tb.importSubtitle: Upload the completed Excel file or enter balances directly, with balance and classification checks.
tb.reviewTitle: Review and approve the trial balance
tb.reviewSubtitle: Financial statements are not produced until the assigned reviewer explicitly approves.
tb.templateInfo: The proposed template contains {{count}} accounts suitable for {{company}}.
tb.templateHint: Review the accounts, add what is needed and adjust names if required. Required columns: code, name, type, debit, credit.
tb.exportTemplate: Export the template for the company (Excel)
tb.dropHint: Drag the file here or click to choose. Supported formats: xlsx, xls, csv
tb.parseError: Could not read the file. Ensure the columns account code, Arabic name, debit and credit exist.
tb.unbalancedWarning: The trial balance is out of balance by {{amount}} {{currency}}. It can be saved as a draft but cannot be approved.
tb.balanced: The trial balance is balanced and ready for review.
tb.submitReviewHint: After submission, editing is locked until the reviewer decides.
tb.submitted: The trial balance was submitted for review
tb.cannotApprove: An unbalanced or incomplete trial balance cannot be approved.
tb.approveConfirm: After approval the financial statements are generated and an archived version is saved; the trial balance becomes locked.
tb.approvedSuccess: Trial balance approved, financial statements generated and archived.
tb.rejectedSuccess: Trial balance rejected and returned for correction.
tb.empty: No trial balances for this company or status.
tb.noApproved: No approved trial balance for this year yet.

review.title: Review & approval
review.subtitle: The certified reviewer gateway: verify balance, classification and supporting records before releasing statements.
review.selectRow: Select a trial balance from the list to view its details.
review.check3: No account carries both a debit and a credit balance
review.check4: Related adjusting entries have been reviewed
review.rejectConfirm: The trial balance will be rejected and returned to the submitter for correction.

portal.title: Company portal
portal.subtitle: A dedicated space for the company finance manager to enter the trial balance only.
portal.companyOnly: This portal shows your company data only.
portal.instructions: Download the template, enter account balances, then submit. You cannot see any other company or edit approved data.
portal.submitted: The trial balance was sent to the controller office for review.
portal.statusHelp: Your data remains under review and is not used in statements until the office approves it.
portal.noCompany: Your account is not linked to a company. Contact the office administrator.
portal.locked: An approved trial balance is locked and cannot be edited.

adjustments.title: Adjusting & review entries
adjustments.subtitle: This page is dedicated to adjusting and correcting entries only, not a daily journal. Approved entries are added to the adjusted trial balance.
adjustments.unbalanced: The entry is out of balance by {{amount}}
adjustments.minLines: An entry needs at least two lines.
adjustments.empty: No adjusting entries for this year.
adjustments.approved: Entry approved and will be applied to the statements.
adjustments.pendingHint: Pending entries do not affect the statements until approved.
adjustments.accountHelp: Choose an account from the company chart or enter a code and its nature will be inferred automatically.

reports.title: Financial statements
reports.subtitle: Generated only from the approved trial balance and approved adjusting entries.
reports.select: Select the company and year to display the statement.
reports.noApproved: No approved trial balance for this company in this year.
reports.noApprovedHint: Complete the trial balance cycle: generate the template, enter or import data, then approve.
reports.exportHint: A separate PDF button and a direct print button are available for every statement.
reports.printHint: Choose the printer in the print dialog.
reports.noElement: There is no displayed statement to export.

analysis.title: Advanced financial analysis
analysis.subtitle: Ratios and indicators for each statement separately, with an interpretive reading and an overall health score.
analysis.noData: Approve a trial balance first to display the analysis.

budget.title: Budget
budget.subtitle: Compare actual against budget and analyse variances at account level.
budget.noApproved: No approved trial balance for the budget year.
budget.empty: No budget lines. Create a budget or fill it from actuals.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Precisely archived approved versions, searchable, restorable and exportable.
archive.search: Search by company, year or title...
archive.restoreHint: A new trial balance draft is created from the archived version and requires fresh review and approval.
archive.restoreDone: A draft was created from the archive.
archive.noLines: This version does not include trial balance lines.

reminders.title: Reminders & dates
reminders.subtitle: Organise reviews, meetings and deliveries, with an alert before the due date.
reminders.notificationBlocked: Notifications are not allowed in the browser.
reminders.notifyHelp: Allow notifications to receive reminder alerts while the platform is running.

users.title: Users & permissions
users.subtitle: Clear roles: administrator, certified reviewer, accountant, company finance manager and viewer.
users.passwordHint: Leave blank when editing to keep the current password.
users.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your current account.
users.portalOnly: The external user sees only their company portal.
users.roleHelp: Permissions are applied automatically: administrator, reviewer and accountant enter the office workspace; the finance manager enters the company portal only.
users.usernameExists: The username is already in use.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: Office identity, currencies, preferences and demo data.
settings.currenciesHint: The value of one foreign unit against the Egyptian pound. Used to translate trial balance balances into the company base currency.
settings.seedHint: Creates 6 diverse companies, approved and pending trial balances, statements, archive, reminders and users.
settings.resetHint: A final action. Export a backup first.
settings.techValue: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 4, SQLite, i18next, jsPDF, xlsx
settings.syncNote: Data is stored locally in a server-side SQLite database, with full export and restore support.
settings.chooseFolder: Choose a folder to save backups directly.
settings.folderNotSupported: The browser does not support folder selection. The backup will be downloaded instead.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.subtitle: Protect the office data: full export, restore and folder selection.
backup.exportText: The backup includes all tables: companies, chart of accounts, trial balances and their lines, adjusting entries, users, archive, reminders, exchange rates, budgets and the audit log.
backup.importText: The current data is fully replaced after validating the file structure. Export the current state first.
backup.confirmImport: All current data will be replaced. Do you want to continue?
backup.imported: Backup restored successfully. The page will refresh.
backup.invalid: The file is invalid or does not belong to this platform.
backup.storageText: Local SQLite on the server. Backups are saved to the folder you choose and can be restored at any time.
backup.autoText: Enable the periodic reminder from settings. The backup name carries the date and time.
backup.folderSet: Folder selected. Backups will be saved directly into it.
backup.notSupported: The browser does not support direct folder saving; the backup was downloaded.
backup.cloudNote: The platform runs on local SQLite with a complete backup that includes users and password hashes. For cloud deployment, use scheduled copies to a secure folder or object storage.

licenses.title: Licences & certifications
licenses.text: A professional edition for the certified financial controller office. All data belongs to the office and its backup is the office responsibility.
